+        # Calculate forces based on repulsion energy

+                
+                # Vector difference
+                dx, dy, dz = xi - xj, yi - yj, zi - zj
+                dist_sq = dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz

+                if dist_sq < 1e-12: continue
